stories.title: Scam texts claiming unpaid parking fines targeting Flintshire residents, council warns
stories.summary: Flintshire County Council is warning residents to ignore text messages claiming they have an unpaid parking fine, after reports of a scam circulating in the area. The council says it will never contact residents by text message about an unpaid parking fine or Penalty Charge Notice. Any text message making that claim is a scam.

stories.title: Met Office amber heat warning covers Deeside from Wednesday as temperatures forecast to near Welsh record
stories.summary: A Met Office amber extreme heat warning is in place for Deeside from Wednesday midnight through to Thursday night, only the second time North Wales has been placed under one.
